name: Product tech pack writer
why: Turns product photos and ideas into a factory-ready tech pack with exact measures, a quick start before the apparel tech pack skill.

name: Product bill of materials builder
why: Builds a cost sheet by part with price-break questions, feeding the cost of goods lines in the quote comparison.

name: Supplier quote request writer
why: Writes a quote request in the maker's terms, matching step 1 of the RFQ pack skill.

name: Compare supplier prices on the same basis
why: Normalises quotes on units, currency and delivery terms, the same rule the quote comparison skill follows.

name: Supplier quote table builder
why: Puts two or more pasted quotes in one table with the cash each needs, a quick version of the cost per unit prompt.

name: Landed cost calculator
why: Adds freight to a quote to get cost per sellable unit and margin, the last step of landed cost.

name: Supplier shortlist vetter
why: Scores factory answers against your spec and flags red flags before you send a full quote pack.

name: Product sample approval loop
why: Checks each sample against the tech pack, writes factory fixes and stops at three rounds, matching the sample round workflow.

name: Sample approval gatekeeper
why: Gives a line-by-line pass or fail of a sample against the tech pack, a second check before approval.

name: Pre-shipment inspection brief writer
why: Writes the inspector's brief and a pass rule for the first batch, the step after an approved sample.

name: Get a product made right, from tech pack to shipment
why: Runs the whole path from tech pack to inspected shipment, a longer version of the idea to factory-ready workflow.

name: Factory price-break negotiator
why: Plans asks and give-backs for price breaks once quotes are compared, before the client decides.
